item_short_desc: Protect your head from extreme cold weather climates with Rothco’s Polar Fleece Adjustable Balaclava. Made from soft polar fleece material, this balaclava is designed to keep your neck and face warm even in the harshest conditions. Its versatile design allows you to wear it with a jacket or under a helmet for added warmth and protection. The adjustable elastic drawstring hood ensures a perfect fit, effectively locking in the warmth and keeping out the cold.
